title: Themes in Contemporary Art Practice
description: Explores contemporary art through a thematic, non-linear approach, framing concepts and ideas for creating, observing, and discussing art. Draws on presentations by living artists to examine thematic associations in artistic practice.
notes: Includes content from the Living Artists, Living Art Lecture Series with presentations by local, regional, national, and international artists.
Speaker content varies each term based on individual research and practice.
